cues.en: So in order to play with neural collaborative filtering, I'm going to introduce a new tool in your tool chest called Lib Recommender.
cues.zh: 為了實驗神經協同過濾，介紹新工具 LibRecommender。

cues.en: So it's kind of like surprise lib in that it's a python package for making it easy to work with recommender systems, but it works with TensorFlow or pytorch, depending on the algorithm.
cues.zh: 有點像 SurpriseLib，是讓推薦系統容易使用的 Python 套件，但依演算法，搭配 TensorFlow 或 PyTorch。

cues.en: So it can do more complex stuff involving neural networks and things that need to be accelerated on the GPU.
cues.zh: 因此能做更複雜、涉及神經網路與 GPU 加速的工作。

cues.en: So it's a little bit higher level as well.
cues.zh: 層次也更高一點。

cues.en: You know, it's a lot easier to use.
cues.zh: 更容易使用。

cues.en: It's not going to make you go as much into depth.
cues.zh: 不需要深入那麼多細節。

cues.en: So unlike Surprise Lib, which is really intended more toward learning recommender systems, Lib Recommender is something you could potentially actually use in production.
cues.zh: SurpriseLib 主要適合學習，LibRecommender 則可能真正用在正式環境。

cues.en: It's going to be nice and fast and hardware accelerated and also using the latest and greatest models, a short list of some of the algorithms it supports are transformers.
cues.zh: 快速、有硬體加速，也用最新模型。支援演算法包括 Transformer，

cues.en: You know, that's like the TI and GPT there.
cues.zh: 就是 GPT 裡的 T。

cues.en: So that's like the latest and greatest cutting edge stuff going on right there.
cues.zh: 也就是目前最新的前沿技術。

cues.en: Also some stuff we talked about before, the GRU for rec algorithm, YouTube's recommender algorithms, deep factorization machines, which we just talked about, and old school item or user based collaborative
cues.zh: 也有前面談過的 GRU4Rec、YouTube 推薦演算法、剛介紹的 DeepFM，以及傳統項目式或使用者式協同

cues.en: filtering also supported ALS.
cues.zh: 過濾，也支援 ALS。

cues.en: We've talked about that before and also neural collaborative filtering, which we're about to illustrate right now.
cues.zh: 前面介紹過，還有接著要示範的神經協同過濾。

cues.en: And there are many more in the list as well.
cues.zh: 清單還有很多。

cues.en: If you look up the documentation for Lib Recommender, also it can produce hybrid recommenders automatically that combine collaborative filtering with content based features as well.
cues.zh: 看 LibRecommender 文件，也能自動建立混合推薦，結合協同過濾與內容特徵。

cues.en: So you can do hybrid recs with it.
cues.zh: 因此，能做混合推薦。

cues.en: It can deal with implicit or explicit data equally well.
cues.zh: 隱含、明確資料，都能處理。

cues.en: And this is a nice little bonus.
cues.zh: 還有個很好的額外優點。

cues.en: Not only can it train your models using the lib package, but it also has a serving module lib serving that allows you to actually host these models and just generate recommendations on the fly from some
cues.zh: 不只用 libreco 套件訓練，也有 libserving 服務模組，能部署模型，從某個

cues.en: server somewhere.
cues.zh: 伺服器即時產生推薦。

cues.en: So like I said, this is more than just a learning tool.
cues.zh: 如前所說，不只是學習工具。

cues.en: This is something you can actually use potentially in production both for training and serving your models.
cues.zh: 可能真正用於正式環境的訓練與模型服務。

cues.en: So pretty neat stuff.
cues.zh: 很不錯。

cues.en: Here's a simple example of what Lib recommender would look like.
cues.zh: 這是簡單例子。

cues.en: This just comes straight from their home page.
cues.zh: 直接取自首頁。

cues.en: So just to illustrate how easy it is to use and even this is more complicated than it needs to be.
cues.zh: 只為說明多容易，甚至這還比必要複雜。

cues.en: We just start off at the top here saying that we're going to do a random split of our training data.
cues.zh: 最上面，先隨機分割訓練資料。

cues.en: There's nothing special about that.
cues.zh: 沒什麼特別。

cues.en: It's just a data frame with specific column names there for our training data users, items, labels, which might be the ratings and maybe a timestamp.
cues.zh: 只是有特定欄名的 DataFrame：使用者、項目、標籤，也許是評分，可能加時間戳記。

cues.en: In this example, we're going to split that off into an 80% train set and then 10% each for evaluation and testing.
cues.zh: 這裡分 80% 訓練、10% 評估、10% 測試。

cues.en: The next thing we need to do to prepare our data is just shove that into what's called a dataset pure.
cues.zh: 接著，把資料放進 DatasetPure。

cues.en: That's a data structure defined by lib recommender.
cues.zh: 這是 LibRecommender 定義的資料結構。

cues.en: By pure, we just mean that it contains only pure collaborative filtering data.
cues.zh: Pure，表示只含純協同過濾資料。

cues.en: So items, users and ratings, right?
cues.zh: 項目、使用者、評分，對吧？

cues.en: It's not including any content based stuff that we might use in a hybrid recommender that would be called a dataset feature.
cues.zh: 不含混合推薦使用的內容資訊，那會叫 DatasetFeat。

cues.en: So in this example, we're just using pure behavior data and nothing else.
cues.zh: 這裡只有純行為資料。

cues.en: And these next few lines are just creating three dataset pure objects, one for the training data, one for the evaluation data, and one for the testing data.
cues.zh: 接下來幾行，建立三個 DatasetPure：訓練、評估、測試。

cues.en: And we also get a info result back from the train dataset there that gives us some information about what's in it and its sparsity.
cues.zh: 訓練資料集，也傳回 info，提供內容與稀疏度資訊。

cues.en: Next, we create our model in this example.
cues.zh: 接著建立模型。

cues.en: It's using the light GCN model as opposed to neural collaborative filtering or something else.
cues.zh: 範例用 LightGCN，而不是 NCF 或其他。

cues.en: And you can see that every model has its own unique set of parameters that you can tune.
cues.zh: 每個模型，都有自己的可調參數。

cues.en: Generally speaking, they'll have reasonable defaults here, but in the instance of light.
cues.zh: 一般有合理預設值，但以 Light

cues.en: GCN It might take a task.
cues.zh: GCN 來說，接受 task。

cues.en: In this case it wants to do ranking.
cues.zh: 這裡做 ranking。

cues.en: You have you always have to pass in your training data.
cues.zh: 一律要傳入訓練資料資訊。

cues.en: That's data info.
cues.zh: 就是 data_info。

cues.en: Usually there's a loss function you need to provide in the case of light.
cues.zh: 通常要提供損失函數，Light

cues.en: GCN You also need to define the size of your embedding layers, how many epochs you want to train it over your learning rate, the batch size.
cues.zh: GCN 也要定義嵌入層大小、週期數、學習率、批次大小。

cues.en: And in this case we're saying that we're going to use Cuda acceleration again.
cues.zh: 這裡指定 CUDA 加速。

cues.en: You need to refer to the documentation for each individual algorithm to know what those parameters are and what the defaults are and what you might want to play with after that.
cues.zh: 要查各演算法文件，知道有哪些參數、預設，以及想調什麼。之後，

cues.en: You just call fit on the model and that does the actual training.
cues.zh: 呼叫模型 fit，實際訓練。

cues.en: Here we're passing in the training data, we have to set negative sampling to true or false, depending on whether we're dealing with implicit or explicit data.
cues.zh: 傳訓練資料，依隱含或明確資料，把負取樣設 True 或 False。

cues.en: Set our verbosity level, set our evaluation data and what our loss function is and what we want to report as the training progresses.
cues.zh: 設定 verbose、評估資料、損失函數，以及訓練期間回報內容。

cues.en: In this case, we're going to report out the loss, the area under the curve, the precision, the recall and NDG metrics as we go.
cues.zh: 這裡回報損失、曲線下面積、精確率、召回率與 NDCG。

cues.en: Whatever you want, right When we're done, we just use that model saying dot predict to predict a given rating for a given item for a given user.
cues.zh: 想回報什麼都行。完成後，以 .predict，預測某使用者對某項目的評分。

cues.en: And we can also do top end recommendations just using recommenders score user on that model as well.
cues.zh: 也能用模型 recommend_user，做 Top-N 推薦。

cues.en: It's just that easy.
cues.zh: 就是這麼容易。

cues.en: So again, at a high level, all we got to do is create our datasets and we do that by very easily creating these dataset pure objects.
cues.zh: 高層次來看，只要建立資料集，很容易地建立 DatasetPure。

cues.en: Here we instantiate our model with whatever hyper parameters we need to pass in and passing in our training and evaluation data we call fit to train the model.
cues.zh: 以所需超參數實例化模型，傳訓練與評估資料，呼叫 fit 訓練。

cues.en: And then we can make predictions based on that model with one line of code.
cues.zh: 再一行程式碼，根據模型預測。

cues.en: So again, you can see this is very easy to use.
cues.zh: 你看，非常容易。

cues.en: There's a lot of knobs and dials to to fiddle with and tune, but conceptually, you don't really have to know what's going on under the hood here to get it to work.
cues.zh: 很多旋鈕可調，但概念上，不必知道內部細節，就能運作。

cues.en: So very easy to use, very much more of a modern approach to deep learning here where a lot of those details and implementations are very much abstracted away from you, but it's easy to use.
cues.zh: 這是更現代的深度學習方式，許多實作細節都抽象化，但很容易用。

cues.en: That's the point.
cues.zh: 這就是重點。

cues.en: So let's go ahead and use this for illustrating neural collaborative filtering next.
cues.zh: 接著，用它示範神經協同過濾。
